name: Do I need a building permit for a tub-to-shower conversion in the Salt Lake Valley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a tub-to-shower conversion in the Salt Lake Valley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing alterations that involve moving supply lines, upsizing drain pipes, or altering structural framing require building permits from local municipal building departments across the Salt Lake Valley. A licensed general contractor handles the permit applications, schedules required rough-in plumbing and framing inspections, and ensures all waterproofing methods and safety standards conform to Utah uniform building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting a tub typically requires permits for plumbing modifications and framing changes, which a licensed contractor manages through local city building offices.
